text: Milk is boiled down slowly until thick and pale yellow; the skins that form are collected and mixed back in, giving rabri its layered texture.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The milk is kept low for a long time until thick and pale yellow.
Jaggery may be used instead, often with cardamom.
The skins that form are collected and mixed back in, which gives rabri its layers.
